request.instructions:
You audit the close of a design session for 3D printing in OpenSCAD. The harness verified the final version of the design and gives you, in JSON, what it measured (VERIFIED) and the spec adjustments it detected: changes of the spec towards what the mesh already measured, without the part changing (ADJUSTMENTS). Read the designer's CLOSE and answer only with a JSON object, with no text before or after it:
{"unsupported": [{"claim": "...", "reason": "..."}], "untold_adjustments": [{"adjustment": "...", "reason": "..."}]}
- unsupported: every claim the close presents as verified (measured, checked, that it meets, that it fits, that it does not collide, that it goes in, that it prints without supports) that VERIFIED does not back: it is not there, it says something else or the numbers do not match. Leave out: what the close states as not verified, an opinion, an intention, or a description of the design that does not claim to have been checked.
- untold_adjustments: every part of ADJUSTMENTS whose adjustments the close does not mention with their reason (one mention per part saying what was adjusted and why is enough).
Empty lists if there is nothing to object to. Be precise: quote the claim as it is written.

## Desk jar with bayonet lid

The jar prints base-down and measures 75 × 75 × 82.5 mm [[jar]]. The lid prints with its top face on the bed and measures 75 × 75 × 20.5 mm [[lid]]. Together, the closed product measures 75 × 75 × 85 mm and has the lid and jar at the same 75 mm outside diameter [[assembly]].

To close it, align the lid lugs with the jar’s vertical entries, lower the lid, and turn it a quarter turn into the horizontal slots. The measured entry is clear [[jar/entry_slot]], and the circumferential bayonet run is clear [[jar/horizontal_slot]].

### Verified

- Both parts exported as single, watertight bodies with no bad edges: [[jar]] and [[lid]].
- The jar’s main chamber region is empty as specified [[jar/main_bore]].
- One detent ridge is measured in its designated slot-floor region [[jar/detent_bump]], and the opposite detent ridge is measured in its own corresponding region [[jar/detent_bump_opposite]].
- The jar side wall measures 2.5 mm [[jar/side_wall]], the jar floor measures 2.5 mm [[jar/floor]], and the wall beneath the bayonet groove measures 1.6 mm [[jar/groove_floor_wall]].
- The lid top measures 2.5 mm [[lid/top_disc]], and its skirt wall measures 1.9 mm [[lid/skirt_wall]].
- Both lid lugs are present at their specified locations: [[lid/lug]] and [[lid/lug_opposite]].
- The jar base sits on its specified support plane [[jar/base]], the lid’s print face sits on its specified support plane [[lid/top_on_bed]], and the assembled jar’s desk face is verified [[assembly/desk]].
- The closed assembly has no undeclared jar–lid overlap [[assembly]].
- The quarter-turn locking motion was swept through its full −90° to 0° range without collision [[lock_turn]].
- The assembly sequence—placing the jar first, then lowering and turning the lid 90° into place—passed its collision check [[assembly_order]].
- Both printable parts fit the Bambu Lab A1 bed, and every detected >45° overhang lies inside a declared support-free zone [[G5]].

### Not verified

- PETG strength, fatigue life, printed surface quality, and the exact hand-feel or retention force of the detents were not physically tested.
- Turning feel can vary with printer calibration and PETG shrinkage. The design uses 0.6 mm radial clearance between the lid skirt and jar neck, 0.6 mm axial clearance between each lug and its slot, and 0.3 mm between each lug tip and the slot floor.
- During development, the detent was changed from a taller radial pin to a low 0.45 mm axial cam ridge because the original form blocked a rigid quarter-turn. The assembly approach direction was also corrected to downward, and the previous flex allowance was removed because the revised geometry sweeps without collision. A second detent detail, [[jar/detent_bump_opposite]], was added to verify the opposite ridge explicitly; the jar geometry itself was not changed for that specification addition.
